stories.title: Facial recognition at city event sees nine arrests
stories.summary: The technology helped police identify nine suspects wanted on suspicion of various offences.

stories.title: Witness appeal over rape on cycle path
stories.summary: The attack took place on a cycle path near a rail line on Wednesday afternoon, police say.

stories.title: New Sunday services added by East Midlands Railway
stories.summary: New services will connect Crewe, Derby, Nottingham, Lincoln and Sleaford stations.

stories.title: Further arrest after taxi driver shot dead in 1994
stories.summary: Ethsham Ul-Haq Ghafoor, known as Shami, was shot dead in his cab on 22 November 1994.

stories.title: Reform selects Robert Jenrick to fight to keep seat
stories.summary: Jenrick won the seat as a Conservative MP in 2014 but joined Reform UK in January this year.

stories.title: Golf course housing plan submitted to council
stories.summary: The new owner of Beeston Fields Golf Club submits plans to put more than 450 homes on the land.

stories.title: Council approves £2.5m school repairs plan
stories.summary: Nottingham City Council's executive committee approved the investment plan on Tuesday.

stories.title: Tram boss to step down after 'challenging' year
stories.summary: In recent months the network has had vehicle collisions, strikes and a number of technical failures.

stories.title: Five boys arrested over city centre building fire
stories.summary: Police say five teenagers were detained following the blaze at Nottingham Guildhall.

stories.title: Cause of fatal shed explosion not found, inquest told
stories.summary: Derek Poole, 91, died after the explosion in his shed in Selston, an inquest hears.

stories.title: MP raises concerns over asbestos in ageing schools
stories.summary: A crisis in school maintenance on a scale of the Raac scandal could develop, an MP warns.

stories.title: Mother excited for son's first Christmas at home
stories.summary: Arlo Smith's rare genetic condition means he has spent much of his early life in hospital.
